title: pd_spectral_toolkit
description: `pd_spectral_toolkit` is an overview of the Pd Spectral Toolkit, a collection of objects for frequency-domain processing, including spectral analysis and resynthesis, complex arithmetic, conversions, comparisons, and utilities. Its help patch serves as a categorized object list; use the listed objects, such as `winfft~`, `peaks~`, or `oscbank~`, for specific operations.
